entries.22b660940bac3053: This is a series of systems covering everything from reception for blood collection and urine collection testing to issuing blood collection tickets and urine cups with patient labels attached, and automating blood collection tube preparation work. By combining peripheral equipment such as automatic blood and urine collection reception machines, blood collection bed display systems, automatic specimen sorting devices, fully automatic urine analysis and aliquoting devices, general testing pretreatment devices and RFID specimen information integrated management systems, it provides a total system for each medical facility. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,892 million.
